Console.deploymentsDescription: Register, review and replace application deployments.
Console.installationsDescription: Manage tenant installations and access grants.
Console.name: Name
Console.emptyDescription: Create a record or adjust your search.
Console.loginDescription: Sign in with your operator account to manage applications, deployments and tenant access.
Console.loginFootnote: Access is restricted to approved operators.
Console.approveDescription: Confirm the live deployment and artifact have been verified. Approval is recorded under your operator identity.
Console.revokeDescription: Revoke this deployment. Existing application requests will be denied immediately. This identity cannot be reactivated.
Console.replaceDescription: Move all installations from this deployment to another ready deployment of the same application. Choose a deadline for compatible old assets.
Console.installationDescription: This grant controls Admin availability. Auth application roles are still required and are managed separately.
Console.mountDescription: The application mount is immutable after creation.
Console.originDescription: Use an origin allowed by the infrastructure policy, without a path.
Console.versionDescription: Required for Next.js; leave empty for HTTP.
Console.assetsDescription: Old assets are served only until this deadline. API and Server Action compatibility must be verified before replacement.
Console.tenantDescription: Use an existing Auth tenant ID.
Console.idDescription: Select a record from the registry or paste its ID.
Console.reviewed: I have verified this operation and its impact.

errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: This account is not an approved operator.
errors.identityUnavailable: The identity service is unavailable. Access is temporarily denied.
errors.unavailable: The management service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.invalid: Check the fields, IDs and formats before submitting.
errors.conflict: The operation conflicts with the current registry state. Check immutable fields, deployment status, origin policy and compatibility deadline.
errors.csrf: The request could not be verified. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.writesDisabled: Operator writes are disabled for this console.
